integrity: The full mathematical proof and a reproducible finite numerical checker are supplied. Finite tests are not substituted for proof. This record makes no claim of independent review or verification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to reflection-symmetric convex quadrilaterals (kites), not arbitrary quadrilaterals; uniform unoriented angle, not randomly selected chords. Critical value coincidences require additive density contributions. Independent verification has not been performed.
title: Exact random-direction width law and a sharp three-peak transition for Euclidean kites
